rdfs:label: mappingRelation
rdfs:comment: Superproperty of all SKOS cross-scheme mapping relations — `exactMatch`, `closeMatch`, `broadMatch`, `narrowMatch`, `relatedMatch`. Asserts that two Concepts in different schemes are related, without specifying how.
notes: Use the most specific subproperty available — bare `mappingRelation` only when the kind of mapping is genuinely unknown. Distinct from `skos:semanticRelation` (which covers in-scheme relations like `broader`/`narrower`); mappingRelations cross scheme boundaries.
